Alexandra Chen  
Senior Site Reliability Engineer | AdVelox Media  
Bangalore, India | +91 9876543210 | alexandra.chen@adveloxmedia.com | linkedin.com/in/alexandra-chen-sre  

**Professional Summary**  
A results-driven Senior Site Reliability Engineer with 7 years of expertise in building and scaling infrastructure for enterprise adtech platforms. Proven track record in designing resilient, high-throughput systems that support global ad delivery networks, reducing downtime by 40% and optimizing cloud costs by 25%. Specializes in Kubernetes orchestration, CI/CD automation, and end-to-end monitoring solutions that align with enterprise SLA/SLO frameworks.  

**AdVelox Media | Senior Site Reliability Engineer**  
*2023 – Present*  
*Bangalore, India | 500+ employees*  

- Spearheaded the migration of ad-serving infrastructure to AWS, achieving 30% cost reduction through optimized EC2 and RDS configurations while maintaining 99.95% SLA compliance.  
- Architected a Kubernetes-based microservices platform using Helm and Terraform, enabling dynamic scaling of ad-hoc campaigns and reducing deployment latency by 50%.  
- Built a centralized CI/CD pipeline with ArgoCD and GitHub Actions, achieving 95% automated deployment efficiency and slashing production rollback time from 4 hours to 15 minutes.  
- Instrumented the entire ad-tech stack with Prometheus/Grafana, reducing mean time to detect (MTTD) incidents by 35% and improving team visibility into real-time system health.  
- Led incident management for critical ad delivery pipelines, reducing P1 incident resolution time by 25% through proactive monitoring and post-mortem-driven process improvements.  
- Developed Python-based automation scripts for infrastructure provisioning, saving 100+ hours annually in manual configuration tasks.  
- Owned the SLA/SLO framework for ad-serving platforms, ensuring 99.9% uptime during peak traffic periods and aligning with enterprise compliance standards.  

**BrightPixel Media | Senior DevOps Engineer**  
*2020 – 2023*  
*New York, USA | 300+ employees*  

- Designed and implemented a hybrid cloud strategy using AWS and GCP, reducing infrastructure sprawl by 40% and improving resource utilization across ad-tech workloads.  
- Built a Jenkins-based CI/CD pipeline for ad campaign management tools, achieving 98% deployment success rate and reducing release cycles from bi-weekly to daily.  
- Engineered Docker-based containerization for ad-serving microservices, improving deployment efficiency by 60% and enabling seamless scaling during traffic spikes.  
- Instrumented ad-platform monitoring with Grafana and Prometheus, reducing false positives by 50% and improving alert specificity for critical system metrics.  
- Led incident response for ad-serving infrastructure, reducing downtime during regional outages by 30% through automated failover mechanisms and real-time alerting.  
- Collaborated with Dev teams to integrate GitLab CI for automated testing, achieving 90% test coverage and reducing regression-related outages by 20%.  

**ClickAd Networks | Junior DevOps Engineer**  
*2016 – 2018*  
*San Francisco, USA | 150+ employees*  

- Automated infrastructure provisioning using Terraform, reducing onboarding time for new ad-platform modules by 50%.  
- Built foundational CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, achieving 95% deployment reliability for ad-serving APIs.  
- Instrumented ad-server metrics with basic Prometheus integrations, laying groundwork for future scalable monitoring frameworks.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | Massachusetts Institute of Technology | 2016  

**Technical Expertise**  
- **AWS**: Enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure design, cost optimization, and disaster recovery frameworks.  
- **Kubernetes**: Cluster management, automated scaling, and service mesh integration for ad-tech workloads.  
- **CI/CD Pipelines**: End-to-end automation with ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins, reducing deployment friction.  
- **Monitoring & Alerting**: Prometheus/Grafana dashboards, incident correlation, and real-time anomaly detection.  
- **Terraform**: Infrastructure-as-code for cloud-native ad-platforms, ensuring version-controlled resource management.  
- **Python**: Scripting for automation, metrics processing, and ad-hoc data analysis.  
- **Incident Management**: Proactive mitigation strategies, post-mortem analysis, and team-wide reliability improvements.  
- **Docker**: Containerization for microservices, enabling rapid deployment and resource isolation.  
- **GitLab CI**: Integration for code quality gates and automated testing in ad-tech pipelines.  
- **Jenkins**: Legacy CI/CD automation for ad-platforms, with gradual migration to modern tools.  
- **GCP**: Hybrid cloud strategy for ad-tech workloads, with focused use cases for data processing and analytics.
